scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
source_title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme Guidelines - National Scholarship Portal
target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary education

eligibility_criteria.social_category: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Classes (OBC)
eligibility_criteria.education_level: Must have passed Matriculation / Higher Secondary / Class 10 or equivalent and be enrolled in recognized post-matriculation courses (Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation, ITI, Professional degrees) in recognized institutions
eligibility_criteria.family_income_limit: Total annual income of parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per annum (for SC/ST) and Rs. 1,50,000 or Rs. 2,50,000 per annum depending on State guidelines (for OBC)
exclusions: Students who are employed and in receipt of a regular salary exceeding the ceiling limit
Students receiving any other major central/state government scholarship for the same stage of education
More than two male children of the same parents (not applicable to female students)
Students failing in the course without medical/valid justification

benefits.tuition_reimbursement: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable compulsory fees (tuition, examination, enrollment fees) fixed by State Fee Regulating Committee
benefits.maintenance_allowance: Annual maintenance allowance ranging from Rs. 2,500 to Rs. 13,500 per year paid directly via DBT to student's Aadhaar-linked account (varies according to Group 1 to 4 courses and Day Scholar vs Hosteller status)
benefits.disability_allowance: Additional 10% disability allowance for students with benchmark disabilities

online_steps: Visit official National Scholarship Portal (NSP) https://scholarships.gov.in/
Register on NSP to generate a One Time Registration (OTR) number via Aadhaar or biometric authentication
Log in with OTR credentials and select 'Application Form'
Enter personal, educational, institutional, and bank account details
Upload verified caste certificate, family income certificate, and previous year academic mark sheet
Submit application for online verification by College Nodal Officer (INO), District Nodal Officer (DNO), and State Officer (SNO)
application_process.offline_option: Submit physical application verification copy with attached photocopies of certificates to College/Institute Scholarship Nodal Officer for institutional portal verification

required_documents: Community / Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar/SDM)
Income Certificate of parents/guardian for current financial year issued by authorized authority
Academic mark sheets of Class 10 / qualifying previous examination
Current academic year fee receipt and admission verification letter
Active Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account Passbook copy with IFSC code
Student photograph and disability certificate (if applicable)
